```yaml
name: Benchmark and CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
      RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: clippy,rustfmt
          cache: true

      - name: Cache Rust dependencies
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          cache-on-failure: true

      - name: Run rustfmt check
        run: cargo fmt --check

      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Run lib tests
        run: cargo test --lib

      - name: Run all tests
        run: cargo test --all

      - name: Build release binary
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Create benchmark results directory
        run: mkdir -p benchmark-results

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          cargo run --release -- --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json > benchmark-results/benchmark_results.json

      - name: Upload benchmark results
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/upload-benchmark-results@main
        with:
          benchmark-results-dir: benchmark-results
          benchmark-name: WAF Detector Benchmark
          dry-run: false
          schema-version: 1
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          venv: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Publish benchmark dashboard
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: WAF Detector Benchmark
          tool: cargo
          output-file-path: benchmark-results/benchmark_results.json
          gh-pages-branch: gh-pages
          gh-repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          benchmark-data-dir-path: benchmark-results
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          auto-push: true
          skip-fetch-gh-pages: false
          comment-always: true
          summary-always: true
          save-data-file: true
          comment-on-alert: true
          alert-threshold: 0.5
```
